inv.title: Invoices
inv.sub: Every placed order's invoice, issued by itself and kept: one number for life, a new version only when the order was edited. Print them on paper or the thermal roll, or make the picture for a chat.
inv.more: {n} more are not in this print (most per print: {max}). Search or pick a view to print them.
inv.emptySub: Invoices appear here as orders are placed. A new order gets its invoice within a few minutes, or the moment it is opened or printed.
inv.noPrint: You can see the invoices. Printing them needs the "Open and print invoices" permission.
inv.waitingNote: An order without an invoice gets it the moment it is printed here.

err.INVOICE_OFF: Invoices are switched off. Switch them on in "Invoice content" below.

set.readOnly: You can see these settings. Changing them needs the "Change the invoice" permission.
set.moreSub: The picture sent in a chat, and how invoices are issued.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card. It was read again: check it and save again.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: You are signed out. Sign in again.
err.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
err.other: That did not save. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the owner.

content.d: What every invoice says: the customer's invoice page, its download and the printed copy alike.
content.enabledHelp: Off: customers see no invoice and none is printed or issued.
content.numberHelp: {number} is the order number, {digits} only its digits. An invoice already issued keeps its number.
content.noteHelp: Shown in a box above the footer. Leave both empty for no note.
content.footerHelp: Leave both empty for "Computer-generated invoice, no signature needed."
content.pairHelp: Fill in both languages, or leave both empty.

print.d: How the invoice prints from this page and from an order.
print.barcode: Courier barcode (once the parcel is booked)
print.logo: Logo at the top (from Brand settings)

image.d: The copy of the invoice sent in a chat, once a chat is connected.

issue.d: Every placed order gets its invoice by itself. An edit makes a new version with the same number; a payment or a delivery never does.
